title: QA run · card:12438 (15/15) · 6bff748b · 2026-09-29 · 6 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 8 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
Checklist run for the manual acceptance card #12438 (Epic #12150, ADR-0126 packaged-metadata customization), executed per `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` by the `domain:spec#5` seat's dispatched runner (seat post #19357; claim on #12438 comment 5893356874). Text-only record; no artifact of this run lands in the tree.

## Environment fingerprint

| key | value |
|---|---|
| framework | `6bff748bbd484f00906c8d9a58f5a3621a20c2e6` (`origin/main` fetched at run start, 2026-09-29T15:3xZ), detached worktree, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + `pnpm build` (72/72 tasks green) |
| objectui pin | `dd3f7e1be3561d63267d7162f3fc0ac52e72834d` (`.objectui-sha`); vendored console built fresh at the pin (`scripts/build-console.sh`, stamp matches pin) from a private shallow clone, not a shared checkout |
| boot | `OS_PORT=38517 objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 38517 -d file:(scratch)/main.db` (showcase), stock composition, boot log `Tenancy: single` |
| boots | boot1 15:41:48Z (no console yet) → cold stop, direct-sqlite probes → boot2 15:49:39Z (same DB file, console mounted) → cold stop → boot3 15:51:36Z (same DB file, `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info` to capture the info-level ledger lines). Run ended ~16:19Z |
| personas | seeded admin `admin@objectos.ai` (server-side: `isPlatformAdmin: true`); stock demo member Mei Phone `phone.demo@example.com` (`org_member`, `everyone`); two admin-created members (self-registration is closed on this environment, `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, invite-only posture): member A (granted a scratch set with `system_permissions: ['manage_metadata']`, positions `org_member, everyone`, no `platform_admin`), member M (granted `showcase_contributor`, later a scratch set with only `setup.access`). Every persona's identity was read back via `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before its cells were scored |
| browser | Playwright core 1.62.1 driving `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, headless, one fresh browser context per persona, form sign-in (token + cookie) |
| execution | sequential, one runner; Tier 1 pins batched first |

## Scope

Selector: every checklist item whose definition cites #12438 or ADR-0126 — resolved one id at a time with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json --include-blocked`. - `packages/qa/dogfood`: `test/packaged-activation-ledger-reach.dogfood.test.ts` + `test/action-params-contract.dogfood.test.ts` — 2 files, 16/16 passed. The first describe ("#12359 — actions and NO automation service") passed all five of its tests, including its anti-vacuity control "the automation service really is absent from this composition".
- `packages/runtime`: `action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts`, `automation-activation-posture-gate.test.ts`, `action-activation-dispatch.test.ts`, `automation-flow-clone.test.ts` — 4 files, 75/75.

- `packages/objectql`: `action-activation.test.ts` — 18/18.
- `packages/platform-objects`: `plugin.test.ts`, `apps/setup-packaged-automation-nav.test.ts` — 26/26.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security`: `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`, `packaged-permission-set-restore-leg.test.ts` — 22/22.

⚠️ `automation-flow-clone.test.ts` is green while the live clone door answers 404 (see F-1): it calls the domain handler directly, so it cannot see the missing HTTP mount — the `dispatcher-vs-hono-route` trap exactly.
